about: Training singlet (training-singlet-textured.glb, MODELQ5 2026-11-19): coloured from the same garment split into 20 parts by Tripo (training-singlet-parts.glb) by viewer/tripo-glbparts.mjs: the body, side panels and hem band the print (Main); the neck band the Collar colour, one even width, its foot one smooth line; each armhole band (its own part) the trim colour as the tee's cuffs, one even width round the armhole, its lining the same. Stitch lines: the neck band foot, a line round each armhole and a hem line, drawn by main.js as thin darker strips.
